source: UNCONFIRMED. CLEISS (Centre des liaisons européennes et internationales de sécurité sociale, a French public body), 'Les cotisations au Sénégal', table 'Cotisations au 1er janvier 2026' (https://www.cleiss.fr/docs/cotisations/senegal.html, saved in sources/sn/cleiss_senegal_cotisations.html, read 2026-11-05). It is a foreign body's summary, not the Senegalese authority, and no decree or IPRES/CSS notice was read: ipres.sn, secusociale.ipres.sn and the CSS site could not be reached from here. Caisse de Sécurité Sociale, prestations familiales: 7% of gross monthly pay up to a ceiling of 63,000, paid entirely by the employer. Not modelled: the floor, since the base cannot be below the SMIG (CLEISS gives 371 FCFA gross per hour for the 40-hour week since 1 July 2023, 237 for agriculture).
